reviews.classification: complete current-size dated implementation/feedback checkpoint with later evidence and authority boundaries
reviews.disposition:
The complete45-line current receipt was read, including the later November4 closure and retained October31 interruption. The earlier below-floor/browser-unreturned and still-unverified paragraphs are historical; the closure reports a rebuilt seeded1920 route with actual damage/heal, native/fight/stored agreement, failed real storage write, save/reload/literal import and withdrawal. No source/test change was needed during that closure;39 focused checks on unchanged relevant inputs are not a new full suite. These saved claims were not rerun here.

Keep the compatibility policy explicit: old in-progress saves can show native full HP and damaged fight HP until the first move derives native health from the authoritative fight. That residual display mismatch is not removed by the new move-publication slice. Label rounding and precise meter/damage are distinct. Stamina regeneration on reload is not automatically lost-cost publication. Source-injected failures, actual browser rejection, legacy fixtures and natural earned play have separate scopes. Ordinary combat/other actors, L2a large text/focus, injury durability and witness/aftermath retain their stated gaps or separate owners. The later closure supersedes only its named gates, not all L2 work. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [UI rules](../../../UI_RULES.md), AD36/AD43 and AD42 govern current claims. No image, JSON, source, test/build/browser, app or personal save was newly exercised; historic allowance and process instructions do not grant current execution.

reviews.classification: complete current-size dated implementation/feedback checkpoint with later evidence and authority boundaries
reviews.disposition:
All28 lines and CUI1–CUI12 were read. The search covered filtered user-role text from351 local logs, with128 keyword hits including irrelevant matches; it was not128 complaints or complete conversation/image/cloud coverage. This reconciliation read the index, not the underlying logs or attachments. Preserve exact user-source pointers and the earlier35-chat sample as distinct evidence windows, without treating these paraphrases as new project rules (AD32).

The durable concerns are whole-screen composition, nearby interaction/context, adjustable panels/readable text, purposeful identity/color, consistent glance/full facts, varied suitable forms/prose, distinct useful world basics, actual mechanical states, lead scene flow, combat/harm home, reference-image roles and real-game fidelity. Current [DESIGN](../../../../DESIGN.md), [UI rules](../../../UI_RULES.md), [vision](../../../USER_VISION.md), current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md) and actual task owners supply authority. A historical complaint is not a current reproduced defect; a gallery or screenshot is not full experience evidence. Later prose-first/whimsy/task-layer direction and current viewport rules qualify old surface suggestions, while mechanical truth, saved observations and reliable feedback remain owned by their actual consumers. Keep relevant CUI references in selected work and preserve deeper backlog in its tracker; this index does not activate every historical request or authorize a new UI wave. No original chat, image, live screen, source, browser or runtime was reopened.

reviews.classification: complete current-size dated implementation/feedback checkpoint with later evidence and authority boundaries
reviews.disposition:
The complete26-line checkpoint was reviewed. It records a reused shared clearance leaf and a concrete stale-participant bug: matching location text did not establish the same actor world. The added world/life/place refusal regression and recorded grade3 sign-out/return/import journey support their exact inputs. Grade2 is rule-table coverage with no invented stock/promotion, not a played issuance route. Public reasons, group eligibility, custody, actual transfers and earned/fixture scope retain separate evidence. The second-world shared-leaf fixture does not prove a whole second source world or its institutions.

Six focused checks, the fresh1920 build/browser/persistence journey and unrun final Q5 full suite are separate. Byte-identical command definitions and unchanged save fields mean no new people/items/roles were awarded on load in that slice; this review does not certify every current old save or later role/clearance edit. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [architecture rules](../../../ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), AD36/AD43 and AD42 optional review govern selection. Historical branch/merge/owner, pre-Q5 completion, normal-app adoption and no-push claims remain dated. No code, rule table, image, JSON, seal truth, private/personal save, native journey or test/build was newly exercised.

reviews.classification: complete current-size dated implementation/feedback checkpoint with later evidence and authority boundaries
reviews.disposition:
All104 current lines were read, recovering the entire file in1–52 and53–104 after a truncated multi-file response. This supersedes the intake's old21-line size as actual reviewed input. The conversation quote's known cost/time, valid recipient boundary, Stop/refund, settled observer knowledge and Notebook consumer are distinct from future effects or interlocutor-private knowledge. The named synthetic route is general transaction/disclosure proof, not a newly qualified canon scene or whole foundational programme. Read dependencies and coordination messages do not grant shared source custody.

Preserve the sequence of partial failed suite, malformed private effect-list producer/preflight repair, completed5133-pass/eight-fail run, serial/focused recovery and joined24-assertion identity proof. The arithmetic5141=5133+8 is consistent; six native timeouts and two reader/perspective defects are the recorded causes, not a clean full rerun. A nine-case serial run initially left one concurrent job-family mismatch; subsequent isolated/focused passes retain their own inputs. Source-arrival hydration preserves the native object/id/state without replaying entry; absent source and arrived source have distinct behavior. Valid commands and malformed in-flight definitions have different compatibility claims.

The later bounded reconciliation records integration by a different session at72a33f15137f2f1788e0d4418abeb573848e2d0d, corrects isolated/joined/final proof identities, retires historical PID/blocked navigation and keeps paid-work pending behavior separate from settled conversation evidence. These are attributed saved receipts; no commit, process, private repair, build or browser was newly checked here. Later dirty method/item/main drift is not proof of behavior failure or permission to rewrite that writer's area. M21/M22/M25's pending final proof at that inspection remains a dated scope, not today's process claim. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [lead-life rules](../../../LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md), AD36/AD43 and optional human review govern selected work. The existing all-candidate reconciliation remains this collection's owner; no new campaign, worker, schema, private source or gameplay gate was created.
